lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: There's something bothering me.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Red and I are very different people.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I think that's why we sometimes butt heads.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I want to find a way for us to work things out better, but I'm not sure how.
Maybe try being a little more patient with her.
Why not just be honest with her?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Yeah, that's probably the simplest solution.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Red makes compromises for me too, so I should do the same for her.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I can be rather stubborn myself.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I suppose it's time I learned to be more patient.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Red's pretty straightforward too.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I worry that if I'm too honest, we'll just end up clashing even more.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: But maybe it'd be better to talk things out honestly now and avoid bigger conflicts later.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: As long as we keep our emotions in check and talk things through rationally, it should be fine.
Do you and Red ever fight?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: We do bicker every once in a while, sure,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: but we both know we care about each other,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: so it never turns into a real fight.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Red may be blunt, but she's actually very considerate.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I don't really say it out loud, but I'm always grateful to her.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: And Blue always steps in at just the right moment to smooth things over.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Thanks to her, even when we butt heads, it never becomes anything serious.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I just hope I'm not the only one who feels that way.
I'm glad that you three seem to get along well.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Maybe we are closer than I thought.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You and the other members of the Counters are all pretty close too, right?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You actually seem to get along with everyone, not just them.
I always try to be on good terms with others.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: It's not easy maintaining that many close relationships, though.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You can't see eye to eye with everyone.
You're right.
That's why I try to say thank you when I can, and apologize when I should.
It's the least I can do.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I'm not very good at expressing things like that myself.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Maybe that's why Red and I ended up clashing more than we needed to.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I should start saying "thank you" more often.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I should go say it right now.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Thanks again for listening to my concerns today, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I really do rely on you a lot.
